content: Pool Ɗyeep Ɗyeel Fin Shindǝm nSiza
Aɓwoon meeteer mo kun, ɗe Festus kǝ jì nɗǝǝn yil mǝ mulki mishkoom fin, ɓǝ wur yool nSizariya kàa nJerusalem.
Yaksǝ pris ɗenan mo, kǝ nennan mǝ nnen Yahudi mo jì kǝ ɗyeel mǝ mbii ɗebish mo, ɗe nǝ, Pool kǝ cìn mo pǝ Festus ɗi, mo ɗang pǝ wur,
mbǝkǝ nwur ɓam mo ɗi. Moo reɓet kǝn Festus lep mmo jì kǝ Pool nJerusalem, mbǝɗe mo kǝ tap ɗaksut, mbǝkǝ mmo táa tu Pool ɗi a ar.
Ɗangɓǝ Festus lap mmo nǝnee, <<Pool wur a ɓuɓwoot nSizariya. An shikáa fen, wen nreɓet yool sham nSizariya nǝ nɗǝǝn meeteer ɗesǝ mo.
Wur sat zak nǝnee, wu yit kǝn mpak nen ɗenan-nan mo mɓut nwun, mo sham ashak kǝ an, mbǝkǝ mmo sat mbii ɗebish ɗe gwar nǝ wur cìn mo ɗi.>>
Aɓwoon ɗe Festus tong ashak kǝ mo mbǝ teer mo pwookun koo kaapaat, ɓǝ wur yool sham nSizariya. Yaksǝ wur tong nkaa mbii tong mǝ tokɗyeel, ɓǝ wur sat mmo dǝm jì kǝ Pool.
Kaaɗe mo jì wul kǝ Pool, ɓǝ nnen Yahudi mo jì, ɗe mo tong nyil Jerusalem kǝ pwoo ɗebish mo ɗes nkaa wur, ɗe baa mǝ mo shikáa mo mo mak kám agaak zeen mǝ pwoo nǝ mo kas.

Pool ɗar ɓalɓal mbǝ shang káa fin, ɓǝ wur sat nǝnee, <<Baa an kǝn cìn mee mbii ɗebish kas, koo a nkaa Wàar mǝ nnen Yahudi mo, kǝ koo a nkaa Lu Naan ɗeɗes nǝ, kǝ koo a nkaa Wàar mǝ mishkoom Siza kas koo lee lee.>>
Ɗangɓǝ mbǝɗe Festus reɓet kǝ nnen Yahudi mo ɗee a shaar fin, ɓǝ wur tal pǝ Pool nǝnee, <<Kyet aa reɓet kàa nJerusalem, kǝn nghan tokɗyeel ɗi nghan mpeemǝnǝ nkaa mbii ɗesǝ mo aa?>>

Ɓǝ Pool sat nǝnee, <<An mbǝ ɗar a ntoom mbii tong mǝ tokɗyeel mǝ Siza, a pee ɗe nǝ ret kǝ mmo tokɗyeel ɗi nghan mmǝnǝ. Baa an kǝn cìn mee shikbish nnen Yahudi mo kas. Waa shikáa fwaa a man azeen-zeen nǝ, baa an kǝn cìn mee mbii ɗebish kas.

Katɗang yoo an kǝn tep Wàar nǝ, koo cìn mee mbii ɗebish ɗe nǝ mak kǝn mmo tu an, ɓǝ ɗi baa an kǝǝrmuut nǝ kas. Ɗangɓǝ katɗang ɓǝ baa mee zeen ɗi nɗǝǝn mbii ɗe nnen ɗesǝ moo ɗyeel fen mbǝ nǝ kas, ɓǝ baa mee gurum mak shin an nsar mo kas. An kǝn reɓet kǝ a Siza tokɗyeel nǝ nghan.>>
Ɓǝ aɓwoon ɗe Festus ɓeetpwoo nǝ ashak kǝ nnen ɗe moo ɓam wur nɗyéel, ɓǝ wur sat nǝnee, <<Waa a ɗang mbǝ dǝm pǝ Siza ɗi! Ɓǝ gha mbǝ dǝm a pǝ Siza ɗi.>>
Pool Ntoom Agripa Kǝ Barnis
Aɓwoon teer mo ruk, ɓǝ mishkoom Agripa kǝ Benis mo jì wul nSizariya, mbǝkǝ mmo sat mwaanlee ɗi nFestus.
Mbǝɗǝ mo kǝ cìn teer mo ɗes ɗi nSizariya nǝ, ɓǝ Festus yakshii mǝ pwoo nkaa Pool mishkoom Agripa, wur sat nǝnee, <<Mee gwar ɗi, ɗe gyet Feliks yit wur a ɓuɓwoot nlushoot.
Kaaɗe dǝ nkàa nJerusalem, ɓǝ pris ɗenan mo, kǝ nen ɗenan-nan mǝ nnen Yahudi mo jì kǝ ɗyeel nkaa gwar nǝ pǝ an ɗi. Mo ɗang pǝ an, mbǝkǝ nghan canɗyeel muut ɗi ngwar nǝ.

Ɗangɓǝ nlap mmo nǝ, baa nǝ a mǝse mǝ nnen Rom mo, kǝn mmo canɗyeel mmee gurum, ɗe mo kǝ jì kǝ ɗyeel nkaa wur nen pee mmo kǝn shínpee nwur, kǝn nwur leshap mǝ shang káa fin ɗi nluɗyeel ashak kǝ nen ɗe mmo ji kǝ ɗyeel nǝ mo kas. Ɗangɓǝ tǝng mo nshee shínpee nwur, kǝn nwur leshap mǝ shang káa fin ɗi akuɗang mon ncanɗyeel ngwar nǝ.
Kaaɗe mo jì mpee ɗesǝ ashak kǝ an, ɓǝ baa wen nɗar ɗi kǝ pwoo nǝ kas, ɓǝ daar nǝ, ɓǝ wen tong nkaa mbii tong mǝ tokɗyeel, ɓǝ wen nle kǝ mmo dǝm jì kǝ gwar nǝ.
Kaaɗe nen ɗe mo jì kǝ ɗyeel nkaa gwar nǝ, mo yool ɗar leshap, ɓǝ baa mo sat mee pwoo ɗebish mo nkaa gwar nǝ, kaaɗe an kǝn pan sǝ kas.

Ɗangɓǝ pwoo ɗe mo sat nkaa wur nǝ, a pwoo nkaa pak mbii ɗe mo a mǝ mǝse mǝ seyil nNaan mo, kǝ pwoo nkaa mee ngwe ɗe moo pet sǝm wur a Jesu zak. Ɗe nǝ, wur muut. Ɓǝ nǝ, Pool leshap ngurum mo ɓalɓal nǝ, Jesu ɗe mmeen.
Kaaɗe baa wen mman mbii ɗe an mbǝ cìn nkaa pwoo ɗesǝ nǝ mo kas, ɓǝ wen ntal pǝ Pool nǝ, kyet aa reɓet kàa nJerusalem, kǝ mmo tokɗyeel ɗe nghan nkaa mbii ɗesǝ mo mpeemǝnǝ aa?
Ɗangɓe kaaɗe Pool ɗang nǝ, tǝng a Siza tokɗyeel nǝ nɗyin, ɓǝ wen nle kǝ mmo tap kǝ wur rǝret, dǝm wul parpuus ɗe an mbǝ lep wur shindǝm pǝ Siza ɗi.>>
Ɓǝ Agripa sat nFestus nǝnee, <<An kǝn nreɓet kǝlǝng pwoo mǝ gwar mǝnǝ shikáa fen.>> Festus sat nǝnee, <<Dǝɗaar ɓǝ gha mbǝ nkǝlǝng wur.>>
Pool Ntoom Mishkoom Agripa
Daar nǝ, ɓǝ Agripa kǝ Benis mo jì nɗǝǝn ɗeɗes mo hakyeng, ɓǝ mo ɗel nɗǝǝn luɗyeel nǝ ashak kǝ pak shiitoon ɗǝnan-nan mo, kǝ nnen ɗǝnan-nan mǝ pee nkaam nǝ mo. Yaksǝ Festus lep mmo dǝm jì kǝ Pool.

Ɓǝ Festus sat nǝnee, <<Mishkoom Agripa, kǝ wun nen ɗe wun ashak kǝ mun jir mpee ɗesǝ. Wu naa gwar ɗesǝ, dǝ nnen Yahudi mo jir, mo kǝ jì kǝ ɗyeel nkaa wur pǝ an ɗi nJerusalem, kǝ mpee ɗesǝ zak. Dǝ mon nkaa ɗyeep ɗoo ɗang moo sat nǝ baa nǝ ret kǝ mmo yit gwar ɗesǝ ɗi mmeen kas.
Ɗangɓǝ baa wen kat wur kǝ cìn mee mbii ɗebish ɗe nǝn mmak kǝ mmo tu wur kas. Pool shikáa fin, ɗang kǝ mmo dǝm kǝ ɗyeel fin nǝ pǝ Siza ɗi. Yaksǝ ɓǝ wen kǝn leɗyeen mbǝ lep Pool shindǝm pǝ Siza ɗi.

Ɗangɓǝ baa wen mman zeen kǝ mǝ mbii ɗewur cìn nǝ, ɗe wen nran Agustus nkaa nǝ kas. Mbǝ mǝnǝ wen njì kǝ wur ntoom fuu, met jir, ɓǝ a ntoom fwaa mishkoom Agripa, mbǝkǝ aɓwoon ɗe mo bǝlǝp pwoo wur nǝ, ɓǝ an nkat mee mbii ɗe an nran shindǝm ɗi Agustus.
Mbǝɗǝ wen naa nǝ ɗee a koo ɗak mwen sǝ, kǝn mmo lep mee gurum shindǝm a ɓuɓwoot, baa ashak kǝ satpwoo nkaa mbii ɗebish ɗe ngwe nǝ cìn kas.>>
